powers.name: Agility
powers.summary: Sharp reflexes.

powers.name: Speed
powers.summary: Moves very fast.

powers.name: Strength
powers.summary: Lifts and hits hard.

powers.name: Vitality
powers.summary: Robust health; high ratings can mean regeneration.

powers.name: Cold
powers.summary: Drops temperatures and shapes ice.

powers.name: Cosmic
powers.summary: Wields the universe's primal energies.

powers.name: Electricity
powers.summary: Generates or channels electricity.

powers.name: Fire
powers.summary: Creates and controls flame.

powers.name: Infernal
powers.summary: Commands demonic, underworld energy.

powers.name: Nuclear
powers.summary: Channels atomic power and radiation.

powers.name: Radiant
powers.summary: Wields holy light against evil.

powers.name: Sonic
powers.summary: Uses focused sound, destructively or to mimic sounds.

powers.name: Weather
powers.summary: Controls storms and wind; pair with Electricity or Cold for more direct effects.

powers.name: Signature Vehicle
powers.summary: A custom vehicle that is almost always available. Rename it to the specific vehicle.

powers.name: Signature Weaponry
powers.summary: A weapon (or arsenal) closely tied to the hero. Rename it to the specific weapon.

powers.name: Invented Power
powers.summary: A new power not covered by the list; requires GM approval.

powers.name: Awareness
powers.summary: Heightened senses, from danger sense to keen sight and hearing.

powers.name: Deduction
powers.summary: Reaches conclusions by analyzing details.

powers.name: Intuition
powers.summary: Reliable gut feelings about what will happen.

powers.name: Lightning Calculator
powers.summary: Instant, complex mental math.

powers.name: Presence
powers.summary: A forceful personality that impresses others.

powers.name: Metal
powers.summary: Controls and shapes metal.

powers.name: Plants
powers.summary: Makes plants grow and respond at will.

powers.name: Stone
powers.summary: Shapes stone to build or destroy.

powers.name: Toxic
powers.summary: Manipulates poisons, toxic waste, and noxious gases.

powers.name: Transmutation
powers.summary: Changes non-living materials from one substance to another; take other Materials powers to also control them.

powers.name: Flight
powers.summary: Flies.

powers.name: Leaping
powers.summary: Makes huge leaps.

powers.name: Momentum
powers.summary: Builds up and directs momentum while moving.

powers.name: Swimming
powers.summary: Moves easily through water; at d8 or higher, can also breathe underwater.

powers.name: Swinging
powers.summary: Swings around using ropes, lines, or similar, given something to grab.

powers.name: Teleportation
powers.summary: Vanishes and reappears elsewhere; larger dice mean more range and control.

powers.name: Wall-Crawling
powers.summary: Clings to and moves quickly across walls.

powers.name: Animal Control
powers.summary: Communicates with and commands non-sentient animals.

powers.name: Illusions
powers.summary: Projects convincing mental images.

powers.name: Precognition
powers.summary: Glimpses possible futures.

powers.name: Postcognition
powers.summary: Sees the past of a person, place, or object.

powers.name: Remote Viewing
powers.summary: Projects senses to another location.

powers.name: Suggestion
powers.summary: Influences others' minds.

powers.name: Telekinesis
powers.summary: Moves objects mentally; larger dice mean heavier objects and finer control.

powers.name: Telepathy
powers.summary: Reads minds and sends thoughts.

powers.name: Absorption
powers.summary: Absorbs incoming energy and redirects it in other forms.

powers.name: Density Control
powers.summary: Becomes denser for toughness or lighter.

powers.name: Duplication
powers.summary: Creates copies, usually not as capable as the original.

powers.name: Elasticity
powers.summary: Stretches the body.

powers.name: Intangibility
powers.summary: Passes through solid matter.

powers.name: Invisibility
powers.summary: Becomes unseen.

powers.name: Part Detachment
powers.summary: Detaches body parts and uses them independently.

powers.name: Shapeshifting
powers.summary: Takes other forms of roughly the same size, limited or freely.

powers.name: Size-Changing
powers.summary: Grows or shrinks dramatically.

powers.name: Gadgets
powers.summary: A variety of useful tech tools, usually made by someone else.

powers.name: Inventions
powers.summary: Self-made tech tools, some always carried.

powers.name: Power Suit
powers.summary: A technological suit with many built-in functions.

powers.name: Robotics
powers.summary: Builds robot helpers.

qualities.name: Deep Space Knowledge
qualities.summary: Knowledge of worlds and bodies beyond the solar system.

qualities.name: Magical Lore
qualities.summary: Knowledge of the occult and mystical realms.

qualities.name: Science
qualities.summary: Physical sciences such as physics and biology.

qualities.name: Conviction
qualities.summary: Driven by strong belief or faith.

qualities.name: Creativity
qualities.summary: Skilled in a creative or artistic field.

qualities.name: Investigation
qualities.summary: Trained in evidence gathering and forensics.

qualities.name: Self-Discipline
qualities.summary: Strong control over emotions and will.

qualities.name: Insight
qualities.summary: Reads people and spots what they hide.

qualities.name: Roleplaying Quality
qualities.summary: A quality you write yourself that sums up the hero's core concept, broader than a single skill. Gained during the personality step.
